claims.text: The Transformer architecture relies solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

Residual connections allowed training of substantially deeper convolutional networks without a degradation in accuracy.
A multinational registry analysis reported an association between the treatment and increased in-hospital mortality.
A lightweight cross-attention module reduced streaming latency relative to full-attention baselines.
The same result was reported in the immediately preceding citation.
The masked-language-model objective was later adopted by several follow-up encoder architectures.
